svg.title: From panic to a preserved commit
svg.desc: Illustrative command guide, not application output. Inspect with git-panic tui. Preview recover with a full SHA and unused branch name. Repeat with --create only after review. No checkout, reset, or uncommitted-file backup.

g.text: From panic to a preserved commit
Illustrative command guide, not a screenshot or observed output.
New branch only. No checkout, reset, or working-file backup.
Replace <SHA> with a full 40-character commit ID. Use an unused branch name.
